visual_inspection: Root inspected overview screenshot: populated seven-day chart, solid colored lines and shaded bands, hi/lo labels, metric toggles and container timeline with gray life lines and blue runs. GPU-expanded screenshot retained; per-device names/units also read through DOM.
interaction_outcomes: Opening sidebar Machine Metrics displayed a populated chart and selected Machine ID.
Expand GPU devices exposed four GPU rows with utilization, memory, temperature, power and clock buttons.
Selecting Network showed Total RX/TX and per-interface counters.
All off left no data-series button pressed in the current panel; Network remained selected as the panel.
All on pressed all visible CPU/memory and Network summary buttons; per-interface series remained off.
unfinished_interaction: The next GPU-panel/reset inspection timed out before any further capture was saved. Browser recovery then reported the Mac locked. No reset/zoom/hover outcome is claimed; prior successful observations remain valid.
limits: Read-only chart inspection only. No host configuration changed, no installation, rental, induced fault, data upload, backend sampling/cadence/retention test, workload diagnosis or account entitlement test. Raw screenshots and full DOM are retained locally outside the committed/exported package.
